title: What Superlens Arrays 2.0 Is
definition: Superlens Arrays 2.0: next-gen lenses beating diffraction limits.
description:
Superlens Arrays 2.0 is next-gen lenses beating diffraction limits. It sits squarely in Future Materials, the frontier where superlenses science becomes array logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are bio imaging-scale. Societies that master array hulls early will shape near-field control practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why superlenses programs worldwide now treat Superlens Arrays 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Superlens Arrays 2.0 needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Superlens Arrays 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Superlens Arrays 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Superlens Arrays 2.0 — next-gen lenses beating diffraction limits.

Phase 1 — Prove (superlenses): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (array logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (near-field control): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (bio imaging): array hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and microscopy-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
